conditions.backbone: claude-sonnet-4-6 (Max plan, no API key) on BOTH sides
conditions.evaluator: the repo's own pytest suite, fraction passing
conditions.gepa_variant: concatenated (stronger variant; per-file cannot edit call sites in unseen modules)
conditions.harness_validated: HELIX's known-good solution scored 1.0 through GEPA's own evaluator path, so a 0.0 is GEPA failing to solve, not the harness failing to score

caveat: GEPA's single artifact for tenacity is 13 files / 83,501 chars, which it must emit correctly in one shot. Its failure may reflect artifact size rather than reasoning quality -- but that limit is itself a property of single-artifact optimisation on real codebases, which is the comparison being made.
